001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.rolling;
002
003import java.io.File;
004import java.net.URI;
005import java.nio.file.Path;
006import java.util.function.Consumer;
007import java.util.function.Supplier;
008
009import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
010
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMetrics;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProviderRef;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.ConvertParameter;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.DefaultParameter;
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.DataSize;
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput;
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutputBuilder;
022
023/**
024 * A {@link FileOutput} that rolls (renames the active file to a numbered archive and
025 * starts a fresh one) once it grows past {@code maxFileSize}, retaining at most
026 * {@code maxHistory} archives.
027 * <p>
028 * Deliberately size (not calendar/date) triggered and only supports a <code>%i</code>
029 * (rotation index) token in {@link #DEFAULT_FILE_NAME_PATTERN} - see
030 * {@code doc/overview.html}'s "Rolling Files" section for why: reopen-on-external-signal
031 * (e.g. via <code>logrotate</code>) remains the recommended approach for anything beyond
032 * "keep a small/desktop app from filling its disk", and that simpler need does not
033 * benefit from Logback-style calendar based archive naming.
034 * <p>
035 * Registered under the {@value #ROLLING_SCHEME} URI scheme (see
036 * {@code RollingConfigurator}), e.g. {@code rolling:///var/log/app.log?maxFileSize=...}.
037 * Every property below lives under the same {@link LogProperties#OUTPUT_PREFIX} as
038 * {@link FileOutput} itself - {@code uri}/{@code fileName}/{@code append}/
039 * {@code prudent}/{@code bufferSize} all still apply and are passed straight through to
040 * the underlying {@link FileOutput} this wraps. The {@code append} setting applies when
041 * the output is first opened. Replacement outputs always append so recovery preserves any
042 * active contents left behind by a failed rotation.
043 * <p>
044 * Failed automatic rotation attempts record {@link LogMetrics#ROLL_FAIL_METRIC} and an
045 * error alert identifying the active file. The event that triggered the failed rotation
046 * is not retried and also counts toward {@link LogMetrics#EVENTS_FAILED_METRIC}. The next
047 * write attempts to recover the output. Archive changes already completed before a
048 * failure are not rolled back. An explicit {@link #reopen()} after external rotation
049 * instead uses {@link LogMetrics#REOPEN_FAIL_METRIC}.
050 * <p>
051 * Only one process should rotate these files. Prudent mode locks individual writes, but
052 * does not coordinate archive rotation between processes.
053 */
054public interface RollingFileOutput extends FileOutput {
055
056        /**
057         * URI scheme for rolling file outputs.
058         */
059        static final String ROLLING_SCHEME = "rolling";
060
061        /**
062         * Default max file size before a roll is triggered: 10MB, matching Logback and Spring
063         * Boot's own default.
064         */
065        static final DataSize DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_SIZE = DataSize.ofMegabytes(10);
066
067        /**
068         * Default number of archives to retain - 7, matching Logback/Spring Boot's own
069         * default.
070         */
071        static final int DEFAULT_MAX_HISTORY = 7;
072
073        /**
074         * Default total archive size cap. {@link DataSize#ZERO} means unlimited.
075         */
076        static final DataSize DEFAULT_TOTAL_SIZE_CAP = DataSize.ZERO;
077
078        /**
079         * Default for whether archive pruning ({@code maxHistory}/{@code totalSizeCap}) also
080         * runs once at {@link #start(LogConfig)}, not just after each roll.
081         */
082        static final boolean DEFAULT_CLEAN_HISTORY_ON_START = false;
083
084        /**
085         * Default {@code fileNamePattern} - the literal text appended directly after the
086         * active file's own path (unlike Logback, never containing the base file name itself)
087         * with <code>%i</code> substituted for the rotation index, e.g. <code>app.log</code>
088         * with this pattern archives to <code>app.log.1</code>, <code>app.log.2</code>, etc.
089         * A pattern ending in <code>.gz</code> gzip compresses archives on rotation.
090         */
091        static final String DEFAULT_FILE_NAME_PATTERN = ".%i";
092
093        /**
094         * Creates a rolling file output provider from a URI reference - the entry point used
095         * by the {@value #ROLLING_SCHEME} scheme registration.
096         * @param ref uri reference, may have a query string of builder properties (same
097         * convention as {@link FileOutput#of(LogProviderRef)}).
098         * @return provider.
099         */
100        public static LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput> of(LogProviderRef ref) {
101                return (name, config) -> provide(ref, name, config);
102        }
103
104        /**
105         * Creates a rolling file output provider from a lambda builder and uses the config
106         * properties from the returned log provider - mirrors
107         * {@link FileOutput#of(Consumer)}.
108         * @param consumer builder lambda.
109         * @return provider.
110         */
111        public static LogProvider<RollingFileOutput> of(Consumer<RollingFileOutputBuilder> consumer) {
112                return (name, config) -> {
113                        var builder = new RollingFileOutputBuilder(name);
114                        consumer.accept(builder);
115                        builder.fromProperties(config.properties());
116                        return builder.build().provide(name, config);
117                };
118        }
119
120        private static FileOutput provide(LogProviderRef ref, String name, LogConfig config) {
121                var b = new RollingFileOutputBuilder(name);
122                var uri = ref.uri();
123                var properties = config.properties();
124                LogProperties combined;
125                if (uri.getQuery() != null) {
126                        combined = LogProperties.of(uri, b.propertyPrefix(), properties, ref.keyOrNull());
127                        String s = uri.toString();
128                        int index = s.indexOf('?');
129                        uri = URI.create(s.substring(0, index));
130                }
131                else {
132                        combined = properties;
133                }
134                b.uri(uri);
135                b.fromProperties(combined);
136                return b.build().provide(name, config);
137        }
138
139        /**
140         * Creates a rolling file output provider.
141         * @param name name of output, not file name.
142         * @param uri file uri.
143         * @param fileName file name.
144         * @param maxFileSize max file size before a roll is triggered, in
145         * {@link DataSize#parse(String)} format when set by property, e.g. {@code 10MB}.
146         * @param maxHistory number of archives to retain.
147         * @param totalSizeCap total archive size cap; zero means unlimited.
148         * @param cleanHistoryOnStart whether pruning also runs once at start, not just after
149         * each roll.
150         * @param fileNamePattern archive naming pattern; must contain <code>%i</code> and
151         * must not contain <code>%d</code> (date based rotation is not supported).
152         * @return rolling file output provider.
153         */
154        @LogConfigurable(name = "RollingFileOutputBuilder", prefix = LogProperties.OUTPUT_PREFIX)
155        public static LogProvider<RollingFileOutput> of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name, @Nullable URI uri,
156                        @Nullable String fileName,
157                        @ConvertParameter("parseDataSize") @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_SIZE") DataSize maxFileSize,
158                        @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_MAX_HISTORY") Integer maxHistory,
159                        @ConvertParameter("parseDataSize") @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_TOTAL_SIZE_CAP") DataSize totalSizeCap,
160                        @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_CLEAN_HISTORY_ON_START") Boolean cleanHistoryOnStart,
161                        @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_FILE_NAME_PATTERN") String fileNamePattern) {
162                var parsedPattern = RollingPolicy.ParsedPattern.parse(fileNamePattern);
163                File file;
164                if (fileName != null) {
165                        file = new File(fileName);
166                }
167                else if (uri != null) {
168                        file = new File(uri.getPath());
169                }
170                else {
171                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("fileName and uri cannot both be unset.");
172                }
173                Path activeFile = file.toPath().toAbsolutePath();
174                String fileNameForDelegate = file.getPath();
175                long maxFileSize_ = maxFileSize.toBytes();
176                int maxHistory_ = maxHistory;
177                long totalSizeCap_ = totalSizeCap.toBytes();
178                boolean cleanHistoryOnStart_ = cleanHistoryOnStart;
179                return (n, config) -> {
180                        var fileBuilder = new FileOutputBuilder(n).fileName(fileNameForDelegate)
181                                .append(true)
182                                .fromProperties(config.properties());
183                        var initialOutput = fileBuilder.build().provide(n, config);
184                        // append=false applies only to initial opening. Recovery must preserve any
185                        // active contents left behind by a failed rotation.
186                        var replacementProvider = fileBuilder.append(true).build();
187                        Supplier<FileOutput> supplier = () -> replacementProvider.provide(n, config);
188                        return new DefaultRollingFileOutput(activeFile, parsedPattern, maxFileSize_, maxHistory_, totalSizeCap_,
189                                        cleanHistoryOnStart_, supplier, initialOutput, config);
190                };
191        }
192
193        /**
194         * Converts a {@code maxFileSize} or {@code totalSizeCap} property value.
195         * @param value property value.
196         * @return data size.
197         * @see DataSize#parse(String)
198         */
199        static DataSize parseDataSize(String value) {
200                return DataSize.parse(value);
201        }
202
203}
